sections.body: A stage-lens review was requested for `Tutor session sign-up sheet` (mid-fi). Reading the prototype link (https://plus-uno.netlify.app/prototypes/session-sign-up/) returned only the application shell title (`PLUS Prototypes`) with none of the artifact's rendered markup or content. In addition, checking the repository for `prototypes/session-sign-up` returned a 404, so no source code or Storybook spec is available to inspect.
Route to human review with Bill Guo (Design Lead) or the product design team to review the Figma frames directly, or update the prototype deployment before sharing out for feedback.
